units.source_text: 于是将各人车辆按照官位高下依次排列，随从人员奔走扰攘，管弦之声一时静止，大家一齐出发。

en.t: Then each person's carriage was arranged in order according to rank, the attendants hurried about in commotion, the music of pipes and strings fell silent for a while, and everyone set out together.

units.source_text: 源氏与萤兵部卿亲王同乘。

en.t: Genji rode in the same carriage as Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将、左卫门督、藤宰相以及所有在座的人，一律随从。

en.t: General Yugiri, the Captain of the Left Gate Guards, the Fujiwara Councillor, and all those present accompanied them without exception.

units.source_text: 源氏与萤兵部卿亲王本来只穿常礼服，嫌其简慢，又加衬袍一件。

en.t: Genji and Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo had originally worn only ordinary formal robes, but thinking this too casual, each added an under-robe.

units.source_text: 月亮渐渐高升，深夜天色异常优美。

en.t: The moon gradually rose higher, and the late-night sky was unusually beautiful.

units.source_text: 诸少年在车中随意吹笛，以微行形式前往参见。

en.t: The young men played their flutes at ease inside the carriages and went to pay their respects in the manner of a private, informal visit.

units.source_text: 倘是正式参见，自然必须按照官位行礼如仪，方可对晤也。

en.t: If it had been a formal audience, they would naturally have had to observe the proper ceremonies according to rank before they could meet him.

units.source_text: 源氏今夜回复了从前当臣下时的心情，轻骑简从地突然来见，因此冷泉院惊喜参半，竭诚欢迎。

en.t: Tonight Genji returned to the feelings he had once had as a subject and came suddenly with a light escort, so Reizei-in was both surprised and delighted and welcomed him with all his heart.

units.source_text: 他此时正当壮年，容貌昳丽，越发与源氏一般无二。

en.t: At this time he was in the prime of life, with a radiant and handsome appearance, and he looked more and more exactly like Genji.

units.source_text: 在这春秋鼎盛之时，发心让位，独居静处，令人看了深为感动。

en.t: To have resolved to abdicate while in such flourishing years and to live alone in quiet seclusion moved all who saw him deeply.

units.source_text: 是夜诗歌酬酢，不论汉诗或日本诗，用意无不精深美妙。

en.t: That night poems were exchanged, and whether Chinese verse or Japanese poetry, every composition was profound, subtle, and beautiful in conception.

units.source_text: 然作者照例见闻不多，若记录其片段，反失却其全貌，故略而不书。

en.t: But as usual, the author heard and saw little of it, and to record only fragments would instead lose the whole effect, so it is omitted and left unwritten.

units.source_text: 天色向晓之时，各人披诵诗篇，不久告辞散归。

en.t: As the sky drew toward dawn, everyone opened and recited their poems, and before long they took their leave and dispersed homeward.
